name: C3_latency_load
_note: C3 latency, under load. Same 10 Hz / 300 s ping as C2, but run while iperf3 saturates the link. The probe plan executor is sequential and does not run iperf+ping inside one experiment, so run-campaign.sh spawns the saturating iperf3 load in the same netns AND runs this latency plan concurrently. One run per load direction: ul, dl, both (pass KELT_C3_LOAD to run-campaign.sh). repeat=3.
